source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_PDB (FRU_PDB power-distribution chassis/FRU) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "FRU_PDB". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes the PDB endpoint, weakens TLS and checks three fields, with no exact IPMI mapping, power-topology proof or no-power safety boundary.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED adds power-distribution topology, full cross-source FRU parity and explicit exclusion of power actions.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 960/2291 accepts direct execution without distinguishing inventory read from power-path testing.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: MID and SCM are different topology/control boards; their inventory cannot identify the PDB.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 retains WebUI/IPMI evidence; ED-34 bounds alternate tooling; ED-35 preserves full PDB coverage; ED-36 treats topology/reference as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify FRU_PDB identifies the intended power-distribution board and that its complete FRU information matches across WebUI, exact Redfish member, exact read-only IPMI record and Project power-topology/build reference, without testing electrical behavior.
original_method: Bind the PDB physical position and power-domain relationships to management objects, collect complete protected read-only inventory and UI evidence, normalize all fields and compare against the approved board record while leaving power and logs untouched.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the PDB instance, power-domain mapping and expected FRU matrix. The agent can read and compare inventory; topology exceptions and final acceptance remain with the engineer.
safety_requirements: Do not invoke power, reset, firmware or FRU-write actions.
Prove the PDB resource/device through topology; do not guess from names.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Do not infer electrical or redundancy function from correct FRU data.
Stop on ambiguous power-domain mapping without retry-by-guess.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the intended PDB in the approved power topology.
Collect complete redacted Redfish/IPMI FRU records.
Capture WebUI detail and normalize required fields.
Compare to Project board/build reference while confirming power state unchanged.
engineer_actions: Approve PDB topology and management mapping.
Approve field matrix, redaction and authority.
Review discrepancies and set formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A partial assumed read only; it lacks topology, complete IPMI/UI parity and transport safety.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve the PDB from topology and actual collection, read exact IPMI FRU, compare complete protected evidence, and avoid all power actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_PDB, WebUI/ipmitool comparison, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use topology-bound complete PDB FRU parity under a strict no-power boundary.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PDB topology/FRU layout and Project build record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact power-domain identity, protected full evidence and explicit no-power behavior while retaining source interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Inventory correctness does not validate PDB electrical operation; a three-field API read is partial.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: PDB topology, device map and expected fields.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong PDB selection may look plausible, and accidental power actions could disrupt the DUT.

project_override_considerations: Alternate collectors require exact PDB/power-domain binding, approval, field equivalence and uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage.
expected_evidence: PDB physical/power topology and BMC identity
Exact API/IPMI mapping and complete raw redacted records
WebUI capture and Project board reference
Unchanged power state, preserved logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests PDB inventory parity; power topology is missing detail, not a competing test purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: PDB inventory purpose is clear; topology and expected values are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds exact power-topology binding and complete safe parity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid and no-power classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Separates inventory reading from any power function claim.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps PDB distinct from MID/SCM boards.

review_improvement: Prevents correct-looking data from a wrong power board and makes the absence of power mutation an explicit evidence requirement.
independent_technical_reasoning: PDB identities are tied to platform power topology, not just a name. The board must be mapped to the intended domain before comparing FRU values, and inventory equality cannot be promoted to electrical-function coverage.
